title: dysoxylum procerum
intro: Dysoxylum procerum, commonly known as Philippine mahogany or kulu, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Dysoxylum procerum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate pain and discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
